entries.hypothesis: The legacy image endpoint was required before creating a KVM site.
entries.experiment: Created a disposable SMSv2 KVM configuration, joined its configuration owner to the Site UID, and queried software_os_version.
entries.evidence: The Site-UID query returned complete image metadata; the legacy endpoint returned a cardinality failure.
entries.rootCause: Image selection belongs to the created SMSv2 Site UID, not a tenant-global configuration object.
entries.correction: Create the configuration, resolve its Site UID, query software_os_version, and verify the returned MD5 before import.
entries.pluginRequirement: Use xcsh_site_image from provider 9.5.2 and expose no legacy image path.
entries.automatedTest: The bundled Terraform contract contains xcsh_site_image and rejects legacy endpoint tokens.
entries.liveAcceptance: The resolved qcow2 passed its published MD5 and booted to an ONLINE registration.

entries.hypothesis: Terraform schema generation caused the POST EOF failures.
entries.experiment: Compared release and development providers, captured secret-free HTTP timing, and isolated protocol negotiation.
entries.evidence: Both payload-equivalent clients failed until mutation ALPN was made consistent with the HTTP/1-only transport.
entries.rootCause: Inconsistent ALPN and HTTP transport behavior closed mutation connections before response headers.
entries.correction: Pin provider 9.5.2; after EOF, GET the exact namespace/name and reconcile only an owned spec match.
entries.pluginRequirement: Never retry ambiguous mutation responses and retain only sanitized transport classifications.
entries.automatedTest: EOF classification covers absent, exact-owned/spec-matching, and collision outcomes.
entries.liveAcceptance: The fixed provider created the site and token without ambiguous EOF.

entries.hypothesis: A generic libvirt DNS forwarder was sufficient for CE bootstrap.
entries.experiment: Observed the CE startup dependency chain and dnsmasq queries on the deterministic 10.100.0.0/24 network.
entries.evidence: Forwarded ce.local searches exhausted dnsmasq and stalled Vector-to-Vega startup; authoritative local DNS removed the amplification.
entries.rootCause: The CE search domain must not be forwarded upstream.
entries.correction: Set libvirt DNS local_only and retain fixed CE, FRR, and workload identities.
entries.pluginRequirement: Reject topology conflicts; use CE 10.100.0.11, FRR 10.100.0.2, workload 10.100.0.100, and authoritative ce.local DNS.
entries.automatedTest: Terraform contract pins the subnet, addresses, MACs, ASNs, and local_only DNS.
entries.liveAcceptance: The CE reached ONLINE, one BGP peer established, the route imported, and workload traffic succeeded.

entries.hypothesis: Runtime hostnames and broad inventories were stable identifiers for approval and teardown.
entries.experiment: Compared site-scoped registrations, deterministic MACs, Terraform state, and live host resources across rebuilds.
entries.evidence: XC appended a runtime suffix while site scope and deterministic MAC identity remained stable.
entries.rootCause: Runtime hostname mutation makes literal hostname filters incomplete and broad deletion unsafe.
entries.correction: Persist the site identity before mutation and gate reconcile/destroy on exact ownership and saved-plan receipts.
entries.pluginRequirement: Use plugin-owned state, names, pool, plans, inventory, and mode-0600 receipts.
entries.automatedTest: Collision, stale-receipt, exact plan hash, ownership-safe destroy, and unrelated-resource tests are required.
entries.liveAcceptance: Destroy proved XC/libvirt/Docker absence and preserved unrelated resources before a clean rebuild.

entries.hypothesis: An external Terraform workspace and a second setup confirmation were acceptable deployment boundaries.
entries.experiment: Installed the marketplace plugin from its cache and traced direct, bulk, dependency, refresh, and upgrade paths.
entries.evidence: The v1 adapter required external state and direct installation could not carry bounded setup authorization.
entries.rootCause: Lifecycle ownership was split between the plugin, xcsh, and an unrelated repository checkout.
entries.correction: Bundle the controller and Terraform root; allow setup only from an explicitly reviewed direct install.
entries.pluginRequirement: Declare setupAuthorization install, atomically install artifacts, resume after reboot, and expose five v2 tools.
entries.automatedTest: Installed-cache and xcsh authorization tests distinguish direct installs from all indirect flows.
entries.liveAcceptance: A clean-host install owns readiness, reboot/resume, deploy, verification, destroy, and rebuild.
